test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer

Statement-I: The p in pH stands for 'potenz' in German, meaning power.

Statement-II: On the pH scale we can measure pH generally from 0 to 16.

options.text: Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.
Statement-I is false, and Statement-II is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The** pH scale **determines how **basic **or acidic an **aqueous solution **is.
 
• The **hydrogen ion** **concentration's negative logarithm **is used to calculate it.
 
• **"Power of hydrogen"** is what **pH **stands for.
 
• Since it is the symbol for the element **hydrogen**, the **"H"** is capitalised.
 
• The word **"potenz,"** which meaning **"power," **is represented by the German letter pH.
 
• We can normally measure pH from** 0 to 4** on the pH scale. 
 
• The pH scale should be viewed as just a number that represents how **basic **or **acidic **a **solution **is. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The pH scale, which is a logarithmic scale, normally goes from **1 to 14.**
 
• Since pure water has a** pH of 7**, anything **below 7** is ten times more **acidic **than anything above it, and anything **above 7** is ten times **less acidic **than anything below it.
 
• A pH of** 5 is 100** **times **(10 times 10) more **acidic **than a **pH of 3**, which is **ten times (10 times) **more **acidic **than a **pH of 4.**
 
• A **strong acid **may have a pH of **1-2** while a **strong base **may have a pH of 13–14 as a result.
 
• **Neutral pH **levels are those around **7.**
